review_candidates.title: Network Administrator - Junior
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Network Administrator - Junior Job Category: Information Technology Time Type: Full time Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret Employee Type: Regular-Long Term Assignment Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% Type of Travel: Local * * * Opportunity We are seeking a Network Engineer Journeyman to join our O&M/Engineering team supporting AFRICOM in Stuttgart, Germany. In this role, you will provide operational network support and engineering for global WAN and LAN environments serving U.S. Africa Command. Your primary focus will be ensuring high availability, exceptional performance, and a secure, mission-ready network infrastructure. The ideal candidate is an innovative and collaborative professional who combines strong traditional network engineering skills with modern automation and DevOps practices to advance AFRICOM operations. Responsibilities Deploy, configure, and maintain secure DoD enterprise and datacenter network infrastructure, ensuring high availability and mission readiness across geographically dispersed sites. Design, implement, and maintain highly reliable and scalable network systems. Configure and maintain complex enterprise routing and switching environments utilizing standard protocols and advanced transport methods (DMVPN, MPLS Segment-Routing). Manage and troubleshoot datacenter network fabrics using Cisco ACI (Application Centric Infrastructure) and Cisco Nexus switching platforms. Deploy, manage, and update Palo Alto and Cisco Firepower firewalls, including centralized management platforms (Panorama, FMC). Administer Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) for secure endpoint access, policy enforcement, and Zero Trust architecture support. Provision, key, and maintain KG encryptors (e.g., TACLANE) to secure classified and mission-critical traffic. Develop automation frameworks and leverage network automation tools (Ansible, Python, REST APIs) to streamline deployments and support Software-Defined Access (SDA). Maintain core network services including F5 load balancers and Infoblox for DNS, DHCP, and IPAM. Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and single points of failure. Create a roadmap for maturing DevOps practices and drive adoption of Infrastructure as Code (Ansible). Gather and analyze metrics for performance tuning, fault discovery, and after-action reporting. Work with operations teams to build automation use-cases and improve reliability through rigorous testing and release procedures. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical discipline. Active Secret clearance (ability to obtain Top Secret as required). 5–10+ years of practical network engineering experience in mid-to-large scale enterprise or military environments. Strong programming/scripting ability with Python, Go, or PowerShell. Hands-on experience with automation and orchestration tools (Ansible, VMware Aria Suite, ServiceNow). Experience with Infrastructure as Code, particularly Ansible. Must meet DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., Security+ CE). Currently a U.S. Citizen. Desired Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CASP or similar are highly preferred Basic understanding of Routing Protocols such as OSPF, EIGRP and BGP Basic understanding of MPLS and IPSEC What You Can Expect A culture of integrity. At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation. An environment of trust. CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality. A focus on continuous growth. Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy. Pay Range There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits. The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is $82,700 - 173,900 USD CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Senior Network Engineer – Shape the Network Services Behind the Nordics Would you like your engineering work to reach far beyond a single platform or customer? At GlobalConnect, you’ll help shape network services on infrastructure that carries more than half of Scandinavia’s internet connections — connecting businesses, hospitals and public services. This is an opportunity to combine practical engineering with service design and turn complex network needs into reliable solutions that work on a Nordic scale. Build services that people and businesses rely on every day As our Senior Network Engineer – Underlay & Service Development , you’ll work at the intersection of network engineering, technology and product. Your focus will be to turn service concepts into repeatable, scalable network offerings across our Nordic infrastructure. Your day could start with discussing what a new service needs to offer customers. From there, you might translate those needs into an underlay architecture, define service models and configuration templates, or validate a new setup in the lab. Later, you could work with OSS/BSS, Security, Operations or a technology supplier to make sure automation, observability and operational requirements are covered before launch. You’ll work across technologies including BGP, MPLS, EVPN and Segment Routing, while using automation and APIs to make provisioning more consistent and scalable. You’ll also contribute throughout the service lifecycle — from technical design and validation to launch, documentation and ongoing improvements. In short, you’ll help turn good network engineering into services that customers can depend on. Your Responsibilities Will Include Designing and evolving underlay architecture for new and existing network services. Translating service requirements into scalable architectures, service models, configuration templates and APIs. Building automation and OSS integrations using technologies such as Python, Ansible, YANG/NETCONF, gNMI and REST. Running lab validation and pilots, followed by post-launch tuning and service lifecycle work. Working across Product, OSS/BSS, NOC, Security and suppliers to establish service KPIs, acceptance criteria and smooth operational handovers. Join the team behind the Nordics’ digital infrastructure You’ll join a Nordic group of experienced network engineers working with Internet, IP-VPN, L2 and DDoS mitigation services. Knowledge sharing is a natural part of the job, and you’ll have plenty of opportunities to exchange ideas with colleagues in engineering, product and operations. Why GlobalConnect? Our fiber and network infrastructure forms part of the digital foundation of Scandinavia, carrying connections used by organizations ranging from smaller businesses to hospitals, enterprises and public services. That scale creates interesting engineering problems — and room to explore new technologies, improve how services are built and automated, and broaden your knowledge across the Nordics. To Thrive Here, We Think You Need 5+ years of experience in carrier or large-enterprise networking, including practical underlay work supporting telecom services. Deep technical knowledge of technologies such as BGP, MPLS L3VPN/L2VPN, EVPN, Segment Routing and OSPF/IS-IS, plus experience with multi-tenant services, wholesale interconnects or peering. Practical experience connecting networks with OSS/BSS, orchestration platforms or service controllers using technologies such as REST APIs and YANG/NETCONF. Experience with vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Nokia or Arista is relevant. Fluent in English, fluency in a Scandinavian language is a plus. Based in either Copenhagen, Stockholm, Uppsala, or Oslo, where we have our offices. Ready to help shape what runs underneath the connected Nordics? If you’re motivated by solving substantial technical problems, sharing knowledge and seeing your engineering become reliable services used across society, this could be your next step. At GlobalConnect, you’ll have room to deepen your technical skills while contributing to network infrastructure that matters every day. Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile. We don’t need a personal letter unless there’s something that requires a special explanation and isn’t covered in your CV or LinkedIn profile. We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis. We look forward to hearing from you. About Us GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences. We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

SuperEats – enjoy affordable pre-ordered breakfast and lunch options. Flexible Work – 3 days in the office, 2 days from home (once confirmed). At Superloop, we’re dedicated to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be who they are. We actively embrace diversity and celebrate the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of our team members. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds to apply, regardless of gender, age, faith, ethnicity, nationality, sexuality, neurodiversity, or physical ability. review_candidates.title: Senior / Staff MES System Engineer
review_candidates.description: Who We Are Factorial Energy is a pioneering U.S.-based solid-state battery company driving the future of energy storage and electrification. Partnered with global leaders including Mercedes-Benz, Stellantis, Hyundai, and Kia, Factorial is at the forefront of developing next-generation e-mobility platforms for commercial, defense, and consumer applications—spanning electric vehicles (EVs), drones, eVTOL aircraft, power tools, marine systems, robotics, and more. The company has achieved multiple industry firsts, including being the first to power a demonstration vehicle with a global OEM (Mercedes- Benz) which achieved over 1,200 km (749 mi) of range, and the first to earn UN 38.3 certification for automotive-sized lithium-metal solid-state cells, the first to deliver B-samples of automotive-sized solid-state batteries to major OEMs. The Opportunity: Factorial Energy is seeking a Senior / Staff MES System Engineer to join our Cheonan, South Korea site. This role takes charge of the full-lifecycle implementation, customization, validation, operation optimization, and mass production iteration of the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) for solid-state & silicon anode pouch cell production lines. The ideal candidate will lead MES requirement analysis, system deployment, equipment data interconnection, process digitization upgrade, and build standardized factory digital management systems to support new product ramp-up, yield improvement, and intelligent manufacturing construction. In this role, you will: Lead MES system requirement analysis, functional design, secondary development, testing, and user training for cell manufacturing processes, covering cell finishing, assembly, testing, and warehouse logistics modules. Realize data interconnection and seamless docking between MES and production equipment, PLC, vision system, testing instrument, ERP, and WMS, ensuring real-time, accurate, and traceable collection of production data, quality data, and equipment data. Conduct MES system FAT/SAT acceptance and IQ/OQ/PQ validation, formulate system operation specifications, data management standards and audit standards to meet automotive battery industry quality compliance requirements. Optimize MES production scheduling, process routing, quality inspection judgment, material scanning, and data reporting logic; solve system bugs and business bottlenecks; and improve production transparency and line operation efficiency. Build standardized digital management systems, including MES operation SOPs, system maintenance specifications, data backup mechanisms, and exception-handling processes, to ensure stable and continuous system operation during mass production ramp-up. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Manufacturing, Process, Quality, Equipment and IT, as well as external system vendors, to promote new production line MES deployment, function iteration and digital transformation projects. Optimize MES data acquisition logic for silicon cell production characteristics, realize full-process traceability of material consumption, process parameters, test data, and defective information, and support yield analysis and quality closed-loop management. Lead MES system technical transfer from pilot line to mass production, sort out system version iteration rules, identify digital bottlenecks in production, and drive continuous optimization of manufacturing digitization level. Adopt data analysis and root cause analysis to solve typical system and data exceptions during production, cooperate with cross-functional teams to complete problem rectification and CAPA closure, and support continuous process improvement. We are looking for people who: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Information Engineering, Automation, Mechanical, Electrical, or related fields. 3+ years of MES system implementation, secondary development and on-site operation and maintenance experience in lithium battery or new energy manufacturing industry. Familiar with battery production business processes, proficient in MES module functions such as process routing management, data collection, quality control, material management, and production report statistics. Proficient in SQL database query and optimization, familiar with industrial Ethernet, PLC communication, machine data docking, and industrial interconnection principles. Capable of independent requirement sorting, function customization, problem troubleshooting, and system version iteration; experienced in production line NPI and mass production digital support. Familiar with automotive industry quality management systems such as IATF16949, able to standardize MES data management and meet audit requirements. Equipped with cross-functional coordination, project management, and vendor communication capabilities; competent in on-site system troubleshooting and English technical document output. Proficient in English for technical document reading, global technical meetings, and technical report delivery. Work Location: Cheonan, South Korea Factorial Energy is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All qualified applicants, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. To request a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, job interview, and/or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ( recruitment@factorialenergy.com )

review_candidates.title: Junior System Administrator
review_candidates.description: At Intelic, we build advanced software for unmanned systems in the defense sector. Based in Amsterdam — with a second office in Kyiv — we are a fast-growing team of engineers and domain experts developing Nexus — an intelligence platform that gives unmanned systems the speed, coordination, and reliability that critical missions demand. Why this role exists We're moving away from a cloud-first setup towards a largely self-hosted, on-premise environment. That's a deliberate choice — you'll get hands-on ownership of infrastructure from the ground up, the kind of depth you don't often get managing hosted platforms. It also means real scope: a significant jump in maintenance work across roughly 20 servers and 80–100 users. As we grow, IT support and infrastructure maintenance have outgrown what one person can reasonably cover. We're hiring a Junior System Administrator to take ownership of day-to-day, user-level support, so our senior sysadmin can focus on infrastructure — while you grow into a genuine partner on servers, infrastructure, and security. You'll join a small, mixed infrastructure and security team, right as we build a modern, self-hosted environment from the ground up. There's real room here to learn, experiment, and grow. What success looks like in your first year User-level tech support runs independently — onboarding, offboarding, day-to-day issues — without needing to escalate the basics You can independently start and drive the troubleshooting process on server and infrastructure issues On the security side, you're able to reliably tell a true positive from a false positive You've contributed hands-on to our cloud-to-on-premise migration, not just observed it What you will own Provide user-level tech support in a technical environment — you're the first point of contact so our senior sysadmin isn't Handle onboarding and offboarding of users and their equipment Contribute to infrastructure and server maintenance, and act as a fallback and sparring partner for our senior sysadmin on routine server work Support the security team in day-to-day operations, including triaging alerts Get hands-on involvement in our cloud-to-on-premise migration Bring your own ideas — if you spot something worth improving or building, you'll be expected to scope a proof of concept and given the ownership to implement it You will thrive here if You have genuine eagerness to learn and enthusiasm for the work — this matters more to us than where you studied You prefer open source solutions over a large Microsoft stack You have 0–2 years of experience in tech support, help desk, or a junior sysadmin role — ideally backed by an IT-related MBO or university-level education You've got a home lab or personal projects you've built and can talk about in depth — we'd genuinely love to hear about them, and we care far more about this than certifications You have a good theoretical understanding of network infrastructure and protocols You're security-minded: "it just works" isn't good enough for you — it needs to be secure, or it doesn't ship Fluent English is a must; Dutch fluency is a plus Why join Intelic Real ownership. As one of only a few people working on IT and security, your ideas will have direct input on shaping how we're built A genuinely modern stack. You won't be managing someone else's Microsoft environment — you'll help build our infrastructure from scratch, with the technical challenges that come with that Growth stage momentum. You're joining right as we build this out, with a clear path to grow beyond user-level support into infrastructure and security What we offer Stock Appreciation Rights programme A vibrant office at NDSM Plein, Amsterdam Noord — where we come together in person every day Flexible pension plan 25 vacation days Travel allowance Urban Sports corporate membership Lease a Bike option Please note that, as part of our recruitment process, we may request a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and conduct a background screening in accordance with our screening policy. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation throughout this process.

When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. About Us SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. What Are We Looking For? We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. As a Professional Services Architect, you will serve as the primary technical owner for customer engagements spanning SentinelOne EDR/XDR deployments and Prompt Security implementations, taking full ownership from discovery and solution design through to deployment, handover, and long-term customer success. This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical role that calls for deep cybersecurity expertise, clear communication, and a consultative approach to every engagement you lead. Strong candidates will come from cybersecurity vendors, professional services practices, MSSPs, system integrators, and enterprise security teams. What Will You Do? Primary responsibilities include: Act as the primary technical owner for customer engagements, leading technical discovery, solution design, and architecture across endpoint protection, identity, cloud security, and security operations with a primary focus on EDR/XDR environments and their integration into the broader security ecosystem. Deploy and configure Prompt Security across enterprise scenarios — including employee AI tool access, developer AI workflows, home-grown AI applications, and browser-based controls via enterprise MDM — while advising customers on AI governance, data protection, policy enforcement, and risks such as prompt injection and shadow AI usage. Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges during active deployments, partner with pre-sales teams to scope engagements and contribute technical input into Statements of Work, and work alongside channel partners to provide guidance during joint engagements and build their delivery capability over time. Contribute to internal and partner-facing delivery documentation, implementation guides, and technical reference materials, while building trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and representing their technical needs internally. Bring technical credibility and a consultative approach to every engagement, ensuring customers achieve measurable outcomes and long-term success with the SentinelOne platform. What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring? Ideal candidates will have: 5 to 8 years of experience in enterprise cybersecurity, with meaningful time in customer-facing technical roles such as Professional Services, technical consulting, or security engineering, and solid hands-on experience with enterprise EDR and XDR technologies including deployment, configuration, and migration from incumbent endpoint security platforms. Good understanding of endpoint telemetry, detection and response workflows, security policy design, and how endpoint security integrates with SIEM, identity, and cloud security platforms, along with proficiency across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments and experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Practical experience designing and delivering AI security controls — including securing employee AI tool usage, developer AI workflow environments, and home-grown AI applications — with familiarity with Prompt Security or comparable AI security platforms and awareness of AI security risks including prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, shadow AI adoption, and agentic AI workflows. Experience contributing to the scoping of Professional Services engagements including effort estimation and SOW input, and experience working alongside cybersecurity channel partners including MSSPs, system integrators, or value-added resellers in a delivery or technical advisory capacity. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to both technical teams and business stakeholders, supported by relevant industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, CCSP, or equivalent. Hands-on experience with Prompt Security, prior SentinelOne platform experience, and a track record of high customer satisfaction outcomes in a professional services environment will set you apart. Why SentinelOne? AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place. We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family: Time Off & Wellbeing Competitive leave benefits Gender-neutral parental leave Insurance & Financial Security Medical and insurance benefits Housing, education and transportation allowances Work Perks & Flexibility Global home office allowance Mobile phone allowance SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting abilities.

Con sede a Roma, helmon nasce per offrire protezione completa e accessibile alle imprese italiane, grazie a un modello end-to-end che unisce servizi cyber e una polizza assicurativa dedicata. Il nostro obiettivo è rendere semplice e immediato ciò che oggi è complesso, proteggendo le aziende in modo proattivo, trasparente e su misura. Il ruolo La risorsa entrerà a far parte del team di Delivery di helmon, riportando direttamente al Security Delivery Manager , e supporterà il coordinamento delle attività progettuali e la gestione operativa della piattaforma Learning Management System (LMS), utilizzata per l’erogazione e il monitoraggio di programmi di formazione e Security Awareness. Il modello operativo di helmon si basa su: servizi cyber gestiti e standardizzati, con un approccio non consulenziale; una delivery industrializzata , supportata da strumenti, procedure e processi strutturati; l’erogazione dei servizi attraverso un ecosistema di fornitori qualificati. Attività Supporto al Project Management e alla Service Delivery La risorsa si occuperà di: supportare la pianificazione e il monitoraggio delle attività progettuali, aggiornando scadenze, tracker, action list e documentazione; organizzare riunioni operative, redigere verbali e seguire l’avanzamento delle azioni concordate; raccogliere dati e informazioni per la preparazione di SAL, report, KPI e indicatori di servizio; supportare le interazioni operative con clienti e fornitori, monitorando richieste, attività e relative scadenze; collaborare all’onboarding di nuovi clienti e servizi e al miglioramento continuo dei processi e degli strumenti di Delivery. Gestione operativa della piattaforma LMS Dopo un periodo iniziale di formazione e affiancamento, la risorsa supporterà il team nelle seguenti attività: gestire utenti, gruppi, iscrizioni, contenuti e configurazioni di base della piattaforma LMS; supportare l’attivazione e il monitoraggio delle campagne di formazione e Security Awareness; verificare la partecipazione degli utenti, il completamento dei corsi e la qualità dei dati presenti sulla piattaforma; predisporre report e indicatori operativi sull’andamento delle campagne formative; gestire le richieste degli utenti e monitorare anomalie e ticket, indirizzando ai referenti competenti le problematiche più complesse. Translate investment workflows and client evidence into actionable requirements with clear acceptance criteria, edge cases, and non-functional expectations. Own the backlog and delivery cadence with engineering leads, establishing predictable releases and a materially improved match between committed and delivered scope by month six. Collaborate closely with design on workflows that reflect how investment professionals review, annotate, and defend an artefact, not simply read it. Make informed product decisions within the platform architecture and engage directly in technical trade-off discussions with engineering and AI teams. Work with the AI team to define evaluation criteria and assess output quality before release rather than relying on subjective review after launch. Protect enterprise requirements that institutional buyers test directly, including access control, auditability, data residency, and performance at real document volumes. Support pricing, packaging, and positioning decisions with usage evidence and a clear view of the value each module creates for clients. Align engineering, AI, design, domain, growth, delivery, and client stakeholders around one current plan; run direct discovery with clients and design partners and convert the evidence into prioritized requirements. Improve requirements quality measurably by reducing rework and clarification cycles between product and engineering. Ship at least one significant cross-module capability into active client use within the first year, with clear adoption evidence attached. Experience working directly with engineering on a modern web and API stack, with the technical fluency to hold credible architecture and delivery trade-off discussions. A track record of shipping products into regulated or otherwise demanding enterprise environments where security, audit, and access control are procurement conditions. Strong requirements craft and written communication, with product documents that clarify decisions, edge cases, and failure behavior without unnecessary follow-up. Professional working proficiency in Arabic. Inception42 is building AI systems designed for practical deployment at scale — across industries, infrastructure, and national-level initiatives. Als Manager Onboard Technology (m/w/d) bei FlixTrain verantwortest du die Technologie, die bestimmt, wie unsere Fahrgäste an Bord verbunden sind, navigieren und jede Reise erleben - von WLAN und Netzwerk-Infrastruktur über On-Board-Units bis hin zu mobilen Endgeräten für unser Zugpersonal. In einer Bahnwelt, in der Konnektivität zum entscheidenden Differenzierungsmerkmal wird und Technologien wie Starlink neu definieren, was möglich ist, prägst du unmittelbar, wie FlixTrain vorne bleibt und weiterhin hochwertige, unvergessliche Reisen bietet. Als Teil des Product-Development-Teams im Bereich Rolling-Stock & Maintenance sorgst du dafür, dass unsere On-Board-Hardware ein herausragendes Reiseerlebnis für unsere Fahrgäste, einen reibungslosen Betrieb und eine gute Arbeitsumgebung für unser Zugpersonal ermöglicht. Deine Arbeit beeinflusst direkt, wie FlixTrain im Wettbewerb um Konnektivität an Bord die Nase vorn behält und verlässliche, hochwertige Reiseerlebnisse liefert. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Operations, Customer Product und FlixTech sowie mit externen Partnern wie Talgo, ECMs und Lieferanten (z. B. Icomera, Advantech) zusammen. Über die Rolle Du verantwortest das gesamte On-Board-Technologie-Ökosystem von FlixTrain - WLAN, Netzwerke, On-Board-Units und mobile Endgeräte - und gibst dich nie mit dem Status quo zufrieden Als zentrale technische Ansprechperson für alle On-Board-Systeme bewertest du Spezifikationen, wägst Trade-offs ab und triffst fundierte, gut begründete Entscheidungen Kontinuierlich überwachst du die Performance unserer On-Board-Technologie, erkennst Probleme frühzeitig und treibst Verbesserungen voran, die jede Reise reibungsloser machen Cross-funktionale Projekte rund um Konnektivität, Netzwerk-Performance und die Integration mobiler Endgeräte in die Fahrzeugflotte leitest du eigenverantwortlich und mit klarem Fokus auf Wirkung Technische Spezifikationen und Netzwerkarchitekturen definierst du so, dass sie ambitioniert und zugleich umsetzbar sind und nahtlose Schnittstellen zu unserer Fahrzeugflotte gewährleisten Testszenarien und funktionale Validierungen entwickelst du - besonders an der kritischen Schnittstelle zu Kund*innen und Zertifizierungsstellen – und stellst so sicher, dass unsere Lösungen im echten Betrieb funktionieren Neue Technologien wie 5G, IoT und Starlink behältst du im Blick und übersetzt deine Erkenntnisse in konkrete Empfehlungen für die Technologie-Roadmap von FlixTrain Über Dich Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Telekommunikation, Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich Mit mehr als zwei Jahren praktischer Erfahrung in Netzwerkarchitektur, WLAN-Systemen oder Mobile Device Management überzeugst du - idealerweise im Umfeld von Schienenfahrzeugen oder einer vergleichbar komplexen technischen Umgebung Ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz zeichnet dich aus, ebenso wie nachweisliche Erfahrung im Troubleshooting komplexer Netzwerksysteme unter Zeitdruck Verantwortung übernimmst du gern: Du bringst Themen eigenständig zum Abschluss und leitest cross-funktionale Initiativen mit Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Teams und Disziplinen souverän Klar und überzeugend kommunizierst du mit technischen Expert*innen wie auch mit nicht-technischen Stakeholdern, ohne dabei an Präzision zu verlieren Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse bringst du mit, da du in einem internationalen Team arbeitest und mit deutschsprachigen Lieferanten und Behörden zusammenarbeitest Von Vorteil ist Erfahrung mit Lieferanten von Schienenfahrzeugsystemen sowie Vertrautheit mit dem vertraglichen, technischen und regulatorischen Umfeld der Bahnbranche Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Was Wir Bieten Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie. Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten. Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige. Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen. Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen. Warum Teil von Flix werden? Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

review_candidates.title: Senior Manager, Programs (DRC)
review_candidates.location: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo
review_candidates.description: GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit! About GiveDirectly In The DRC GiveDirectly DRC was established in 2018 to enable cash transfers to poor and rural populations via mobile phones, thereby promoting food security, poverty reduction, and financial inclusion. We aimed to demonstrate the operational feasibility and cost-effectiveness of transferring large volumes of money digitally in one of the world's least developed countries. Since its inception four years ago, GiveDirectly DRC has used mobile phones to transfer over $14 million to more than 65,000 beneficiaries in four provinces: South Kivu, North Kivu, Ituri, and Kinshasa. GiveDirectly's activities in the DRC have expanded to include, among other things: compelling proofs of concept for mobile-based cash transfers; and the implementation of innovative technologies to target disadvantaged urban populations in Kinshasa, in collaboration with the DRC's social protection agency, the DRC Social Fund. The delivery of contactless cash to beneficiaries in Beni and Bunia affected by the economic consequences of COVID-19. You will be joining Give Directly DRC at an exciting time in its history, as we are establishing and hope to launch several new programs and strengthen our partnership with the DRC government. About The Role As Senior Manager, Programs (DRC), you'll help bring GiveDirectly's programs in the Democratic Republic of Congo to life — owning their end-to-end execution, from operational design to on-the-ground delivery. You'll blend strategic thinking with hands-on problem-solving: designing systems that work, catching risks before they escalate, and using data to drive continuous improvement. You'll also lead people, managing a team of managers and field staff, while partnering closely with the Program Director and Country Director to shape what comes next. It's a role for someone who's energized by both the big picture and the operational details that make it real. What You’ll Do Develop detailed project management plans for all our programs and drive them through successful end-to-end execution Design operational models for new programs — including targeting, payments, and customer service — and define, monitor, and report on key operational and efficiency indicators Identify operational vulnerabilities, such as fraud or reputational risk, and implement mitigation solutions aligned with the risk framework set by the Program Director Analyze program-level data to diagnose the causes of underperformance and drive continuous quality improvement Partner with Tech and Data teams to design surveys and ensure data integrity in Salesforce Directly manage a team of managers, with oversight of field teams and call centre at multiple levels Support the Program Director and Country Director in scoping new programs, including operational feasibility and risk assessment. Manage partner relationships with key operational partners with oversight of scoping, contracting and ensuring the terms of our agreements are respected. Develop materials for engagement with donors and other external stakeholders in order to represent our work externally. Requirements Minimum 6 years of experience managing and implementing programs within international NGOs or a comparable operational environment; experience in cash or money transfer programming is an asset Work experience in the DRC, or strong knowledge of the DRC context, is highly desirable Experience in team management, including recruitment, team building, and development Strong analytical thinking, with a proven ability to use data to identify problems and improve programs Experience using technology and digital tools to drive results and operational innovation Proven instinct for risk management and creative problem-solving in complex operational environments A high degree of autonomy and resilience, with the ability to thrive in a fragile, rapidly changing environment Strong alignment with GiveDirectly's values Excellent written and oral communication skills, including ability to communicate fluently in English and French with high level stakeholders Professional proficiency in French and English required; knowledge of Congolese Swahili and/or Lingala is an asset Compensation At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here . Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income. Base Salary: $94,500 Bonus at Target Performance: 10% (~$9,450, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be $11,057 in 2025) Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $103,950+ This role is onsite in Goma, DRC. We welcome candidates based in the DRC as well as those willing to relocate to be based in the DRC. Working at GiveDirectly GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant. Commitment to Safeguarding As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens. These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff. **GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing, reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.** Reasonable Accommodations We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at careers@givedirectly.org with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs. Want to put your best foot forward on your GiveDirectly application? Take a look at our Candidate Application Prep Guide ! Referrals Know the right person for this role? Please consider referring them . We offer a reward of $3,000 for a Senior Manager or above role, and $500 for a Manager role, paid if we end up hiring your referral. Thank you for sending great people our way!

review_candidates.title: Senior Integrated Social Services Associate
review_candidates.description: Job Highlight L’Integrated Social Services Associate apportera un appui technique et opérationnel à la mise en œuvre, au suivi et à la coordination des activités conjointes UNICEF–MAS. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes du Ministère des Affaires Sociales et les spécialistes de l’UNICEF, il/elle contribuera au renforcement des capacités, au suivi des interventions et à la documentation des résultats afin de soutenir la mise en œuvre de l’approche intégrée du travail social. Le/la titulaire du poste sera placé(e) sous la supervision principale du/de la Social Policy Specialist (NO3) et bénéficiera d’une supervision technique du/de la Child Protection Specialist (NO3). About About the Project Office En Tunisie, l’UNICEF appuie le Gouvernement dans le renforcement des systèmes et des politiques publiques visant à garantir les droits et le bien-être des enfants. Dans les domaines de la protection sociale et de la protection de l’enfance, l’organisation accompagne le Ministère des Affaires Sociales (MAS) dans le développement de systèmes plus inclusifs, efficaces et résilients, notamment à travers le renforcement des capacités institutionnelles, l’amélioration des mécanismes de coordination intersectoriels, le développement des systèmes d’information et la production d’évidences pour éclairer les politiques publiques. Dans le cadre de ce partenariat, l’UNICEF soutient le développement d’une approche intégrée du travail social (social services workforce integration) favorisant une meilleure articulation entre les systèmes de protection sociale et de protection de l’enfance afin d’assurer un continuum de services pour les enfants vulnérables et leurs familles. Cette approche vise à renforcer la coordination entre les acteurs, les mécanismes de référencement et les capacités des travailleurs sociaux et d’autres intervenants de première ligne des services à l’enfance pour améliorer l’accès à des services de qualité. Le/La Senior Integrated Social Services Associate apportera un appui technique et opérationnel à la mise en œuvre, au suivi et à la coordination des activités conjointes UNICEF–MAS. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes du Ministère des Affaires Sociales et les spécialistes de l’UNICEF, il/elle contribuera au renforcement des capacités, au suivi des interventions et à la documentation des résultats afin de soutenir la mise en œuvre de l’approche intégrée du travail social. Le/la titulaire du poste sera placé(e) sous la supervision principale du/de la Social Policy Specialist (NO3) et bénéficiera d’une supervision technique du/de la Child Protection Specialist (NO3). Role Purpose L’Associate contribue à la mise en œuvre efficace des activités conjointes UNICEF–Ministère des Affaires Sociales en matière de protection sociale, de protection de l’enfance et de travail social intégré. À travers son appui à la coordination, au renforcement des capacités, au suivi des interventions et à l’intégration des services, il/elle contribue à améliorer l’accès des enfants vulnérables et de leurs familles aux prestations sociales et aux services essentiels. Les résultats de cette fonction soutiennent le renforcement des systèmes nationaux et favorisent la mise en place d’un continuum de services plus coordonné, inclusif et centré sur les besoins des enfants. Des missions sur le terrain en dehors de Tunis seront à prévoir, notamment afin d’accompagner la mise en œuvre et le suivi des activités sur le terrain. Elles seront pris en charge par l’UNICEF. Child Safeguarding Le/la titulaire du poste adhère aux politiques de l’UNICEF en matière de sauvegarde de l’enfant, de prévention de l’exploitation et des abus sexuels (PSEA) et de conduite éthique. Il/elle veille à intégrer les principes de protection de l’enfant dans toutes les activités relevant de sa fonction et à signaler toute préoccupation ou risque potentiel conformément aux procédures de l’UNICEF. Functions / Key Results Expected Mise en œuvre et coordination du programme Appuyer la mise en œuvre et le suivi des activités conjointes UNICEF–MAS. Faciliter la coordination entre les directions du Ministère, l’UNICEF et les partenaires. Contribuer à la planification et au suivi des réunions, missions et plans de travail. Contribuer à la coordination entre les interventions de protection sociale et de protection de l’enfance dans le cadre de l’approche intégrée du travail social. Renforcement des capacités Contribuer à l’organisation et au suivi des activités de renforcement des capacités des travailleurs sociaux. Appuyer la préparation des supports de formation et le suivi des résultats des formations. Contribuer à la diffusion des bonnes pratiques en matière de protection sociale, de protection de l’enfance et de travail social intégré. Travail social intégré et mécanismes de référencement Appuyer les activités visant à renforcer la coordination et les mécanismes de référencement entre les systèmes de protection sociale et de protection de l’enfance. Contribuer au suivi des initiatives favorisant l’accès des enfants et de leurs familles à un continuum de services. Contribuer à l’amélioration des mécanismes d’orientation et de référencement entre les services sociaux concernés. Suivi, rapportage et gestion des connaissances Contribuer au suivi des activités, à la collecte et à l’analyse des données. Participer à la préparation des rapports, produits de connaissance et supports de communication. Documenter les résultats, les bonnes pratiques et les leçons apprises. Appui transversal Fournir un appui technique et opérationnel aux priorités du Programme de Pays UNICEF–MAS et ses Plans de travail annuels. Contribuer à l’organisation des réunions, ateliers et autres activités programmatiques. Exécuter toute autre tâche pertinente confiée par les superviseurs. Education Requirements Obligatoire :Diplôme de baccalauréat est requis Souhaitée : Diplôme universitaire de niveau Licence est souhaitable en sciences politiques, relations internationales, travail social, sociologie, psychologie, droit ou dans un domaine connexe et peut remplacer 4 années de l’expérience requise. Diplôme universitaire de niveau Master souhaité en sciences politiques, relations internationales, travail social, sociologie, psychologie, droit ou dans un domaine connexe et peut remplacer jusqu’à 5 années de l’expérience requise. Requirements Experience Requirements Obligatoire : Six (6) ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente Expérience de travail avec des institutions publiques, notamment dans le secteur social, est fortement souhaitée. Expérience dans la coordination d’activités, le suivi de programmes et l’organisation d’actions de renforcement des capacités constitue un atout. Souhaitée : Expérience auprès d’institutions gouvernementales, particulièrement dans le secteur social, et/ou au sein du système des Nations Unies constitue un atout

Responsabilità: La risorsa avrà le seguenti responsabilità: Coordinare le attività di controllo costi delle commesse assegnate, supervisionando e coordinando i Cost Controller operativi sui diversi cantieri; Monitorare l’andamento economico-finanziario dei progetti, collegando strettamente i dati economici all’avanzamento effettivo dei lavori in cantiere e garantendo il rispetto dei budget approvati; Predisporre la reportistica periodica di controllo di gestione a supporto del management; Effettuare analisi degli scostamenti tra dati previsionali e consuntivi, individuandone le cause e proponendo tempestivamente le relative azioni correttive; Supportare le attività di revisione e aggiornamento dei budget di commessa; Collaborare a stretto contatto con le funzioni tecniche e operative per la raccolta e l'analisi sul campo dei dati economici di progetto; Garantire l’accuratezza e l’affidabilità delle informazioni economiche e gestionali di commessa. Background The Principal is part of the Regional Policy and Strategy (RPS) team. The RPS team designs and delivers, in close coordination with PSD, CSD and Banking teams, the Bank’s policy agenda in each of its countries of operations. They will have a strong content focus in Human Capital, Skills, Gender and Inclusion, and work closely with the GEI experts based across Headquarter and RO (matrix management). G&EI is part of the Vice Presidency for Policy and Partnerships, and within that the Policy and Strategy Delivery department (PSD). PSD consists of approximately 140 staff that support technical assistance and policy engagement across the Bank’s transition qualities (except for green), political assessments, country strategy development and economic assessments as well as to support the Bank’s compliance with Article 1. Facts / Scale The Principal leads the design, development, and implementation of Gender Equality and Human Capital donor-funded TCs of EBRD investments (SIG and ICA projects) in coordination with the RPL team, in Morocco and Tunisia. The Principal acts as the Operational Lead for a portfolio of existing donor-TC implementation projects in Morocco and Tunisia and will develop new ones. The Principal has expertise in engaging on Human Capital, Skills, Gender and Economic Inclusion with a specific focus on youth inclusion, migration and refugees, skills development, financial inclusion, and/or disability inclusion in SEMED and works across thematic teams within G&EI. The Principal is responsible for the implementation of ongoing Technical Cooperation assignments (TCs) for both project and policy level activities, including the successful selection and management of consultants, the delivery of outputs on time and to budget, as well as related donor engagement, reporting, and, at times, fundraising. The Principal, G&EI works closely with G&EI HQ, Morocco and Tunisia RO banking teams and the RPS SEMED Team for policy reform activities. The Principal has management responsibilities for one resource in Tunisia (Assistant Analyst, Tunisia RO). No budget responsibility. Accountabilities & Responsibilities In line with the Bank’s Transition mandate, supports the Banking teams in designing and implementing Human Capital, Skills and Gender activities through Donor-funded Technical Cooperation (TCs) supporting EBRD’s investment, including the design of TORs, selection and management of consultants, and monitoring of impact and lessons learned (skills development, youth, gender and other human capital related areas of work); As part of the Bank’s Scorecard, advises on the inclusion element for transition ratings and monitoring of inclusion related transition impact benchmarks, covering projects for the Bank’s Operational Committees (Ops Com, SBIC, and TC Com); Supports Human Capital, Skills, Gender, and Economic Inclusion capacity building within the Bank, specifically in Banking teams and Regional / Resident Offices, through presentations, workshops and seminars; Tracks and reports on the impact of GEI engagements in the Maghreb, preparing donor progress reports, case studies and communication materials that capture key lessons learned and demonstrate EBRD's impact on gender equality and human capital development; Represents GEI in relevant country-level donor and partnership working groups and selected events with local and international partners; supports knowledge generation and visibility activities in line with EBRD's strategic commitment to human capital development and gender equality; Contributes to joint work across departments and across Pillars as needed. Knowledge, Skills, Experience & Qualifications A postgraduate degree in economics, international relations, international development or related field Experience in working with the design and management of donor funded projects though Technical Cooperation; Demonstrated policy or development / inclusion / gender expertise and prior work experience in policy-oriented or development area, gained for example through full-time employment in a financial or governmental institution, development agency, consultancy/company, think tank or academia; Knowledge and experience in project management: implementation and delivery of consultancy-based work and outcomes. Excellent written and oral communication skills in English and French; Good interpersonal skills; Familiarity with the SEMED region and work or study experience in Morocco or Tunisia is helpful; Strong analytical and quantitative skills would be an advantage; What is it like to work at the EBRD? The EBRD Environment Provides You With Varied, stimulating and engaging work that gives you an opportunity to interact with a wide range of experts in the financial, political, public and private sectors across the regions we invest in; A working culture that embraces inclusion and celebrates diversity; An environment that places sustainability, equality and digital transformation at the heart of what we do. Diversity is one of the Bank’s core values which are at the heart of everything it does. A diverse workforce with the right knowledge and skills enables connection with our clients, brings pioneering ideas, energy and innovation. The EBRD staff is characterised by its rich diversity of nationalities, cultures and opinions and we aim to sustain and build on this strength. As such, the EBRD seeks to ensure that everyone is treated with respect and given equal opportunities and works in an inclusive environment. The EBRD encourages all qualified candidates who are nationals of the EBRD member countries to apply regardless of their racial, ethnic, religious and cultural background, gender, sexual orientation or disabilities. As an inclusive employer, we promote flexible working and expecting our employee to attend the office 50% of their working time. Please note, that due to the high volume of applications received, we regret to inform you that we are unable to provide detailed feedback to candidates who have not been shortlisted (for further consideration).

Job Description Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership Define and deploy the regional quality strategy for Grid Automation MENAT in alignment with global business quality priorities, the Zero Defect framework, and Lean operating principles. Lead transformation initiatives to improve process capability, execution discipline, product and project quality, and customer outcomes across the region. Establish and drive regional quality goals, KPIs, and operating rhythms focused on prevention, flow, waste reduction, execution excellence, and continuous improvement. Ensure strong quality governance across projects, services, Integration Facilities, and regional operations, with clear accountability, tiered escalation, and disciplined follow-through. Promote a culture of Lean thinking by embedding standardization, visual management, daily management, Kaizen, and PSR into regional quality processes. Drive simplification and harmonization of quality processes across MENAT to reduce variation, improve responsiveness, and increase process maturity. Project & Operational Quality Own quality performance across the regional project and service execution lifecycle. Ensure effective deployment of quality controls, quality gates, control plans, risk reviews, and lessons learned throughout project execution. Lead robust management of non-conformances, PSR, root cause analysis, and corrective/preventive actions to ensure timely closure and sustainable improvements. Improve process flow and execution consistency by standardizing key quality deliverables, handoff points, and escalation practices across the region. Integration Facilities Quality Initiatives Lead the quality strategy and improvement roadmap for regional Integration Facilities, ensuring robust process control, standardization, and right-first-time panel, cubicle, and system integration. Drive preventive quality initiatives across Integration Facilities to reduce wiring defects, configuration errors, missing documentation, testing escapes, rework, and late-stage nonconformances. Improve traceability, defect capture, and feedback loops between Engineering, Sourcing, Integration Facilities, and Project teams to ensure recurring issues are addressed at the root cause. Lead Kaizen initiatives within Integration Facilities to improve workstation discipline, material flow, standard work adherence, visual management, and first-pass yield. Drive PSR and root cause rigor for major defects and repeat issues originating in Integration Facilities, ensuring sustainable corrective and preventive actions. Customer Quality & Stakeholder Engagement Serve as the regional quality leader for critical customer issues and escalations, ensuring strong ownership, transparent communication, and timely resolution. Partner with commercial, project, and service teams to strengthen customer confidence and improve customer quality experience across the MENAT region. Lead customer issue resolution processes with strong discipline around containment, PSR, root cause analysis, corrective actions, verification of effectiveness, and prevention of recurrence. Use customer feedback, complaints, warranty trends, commissioning findings, and field issue data to identify systemic gaps and prioritize Kaizen and Lean improvement actions, especially where issues originate in Integration Facilities. Quality Management System, Compliance & Lean Operating Rhythm Ensure consistent deployment and compliance of the Quality Management System (QMS), business processes, and applicable regional and regulatory requirements across MENAT. Support internal and external audits, customer inspections, and compliance reviews, ensuring readiness, rapid response, and timely closure of findings. Drive standardization of quality tools, reporting, leader standard work, and governance practices across projects, Integration Facilities, and operations in the region. Establish Lean management rhythms including daily management, KPI reviews, operating cadences, PSR forums, Kaizen events, problem-solving reviews, and action tracking to sustain quality improvements. Data, KPIs & Continuous Improvement Define and monitor key regional quality metrics such as NCR trend and aging, COPQ, defect leakage, first-time quality, test failure trends, audit findings, customer complaints, warranty trends, process adherence, and corrective action closure effectiveness. Track Integration Facility-specific KPIs such as first-pass yield, rework rate, wiring defects, documentation errors, test escapes, punch list closure, and on-time release quality. Use data analytics and visual management to identify systemic issues, separate signal from noise, and prioritize the highest-impact quality and Lean initiatives. Lead continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and structured problem-solving methodologies such as Kaizen, 5 Why, Ishikawa, PSR, Kaizen, and mistake-proofing concepts. Track and improve process capability, cycle-time losses related to quality escapes, and recurring failure modes to improve business performance and customer outcomes. Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems and practical experience applying quality tools and methodologies in a business environment. Demonstrated Lean experience, including use of standard work, daily management, visual management, Kaizen, PSR, and structured problem-solving in operational settings. Proven expertise in root cause analysis and problem-solving methodologies such as PSR, 5 Why, and Ishikawa. Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal. Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers and senior business leaders. Systems thinker with the ability to understand how process variation impacts the full project and customer value stream. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

new_matches.title: Senior Network Engineer
new_matches.description: Senior Network Engineer – Shape the Network Services Behind the Nordics Would you like your engineering work to reach far beyond a single platform or customer? At GlobalConnect, you’ll help shape network services on infrastructure that carries more than half of Scandinavia’s internet connections — connecting businesses, hospitals and public services. This is an opportunity to combine practical engineering with service design and turn complex network needs into reliable solutions that work on a Nordic scale. Build services that people and businesses rely on every day As our Senior Network Engineer – Underlay & Service Development , you’ll work at the intersection of network engineering, technology and product. Your focus will be to turn service concepts into repeatable, scalable network offerings across our Nordic infrastructure. Your day could start with discussing what a new service needs to offer customers. From there, you might translate those needs into an underlay architecture, define service models and configuration templates, or validate a new setup in the lab. Later, you could work with OSS/BSS, Security, Operations or a technology supplier to make sure automation, observability and operational requirements are covered before launch. You’ll work across technologies including BGP, MPLS, EVPN and Segment Routing, while using automation and APIs to make provisioning more consistent and scalable. You’ll also contribute throughout the service lifecycle — from technical design and validation to launch, documentation and ongoing improvements. In short, you’ll help turn good network engineering into services that customers can depend on. Your Responsibilities Will Include Designing and evolving underlay architecture for new and existing network services. Translating service requirements into scalable architectures, service models, configuration templates and APIs. Building automation and OSS integrations using technologies such as Python, Ansible, YANG/NETCONF, gNMI and REST. Running lab validation and pilots, followed by post-launch tuning and service lifecycle work. Working across Product, OSS/BSS, NOC, Security and suppliers to establish service KPIs, acceptance criteria and smooth operational handovers. Join the team behind the Nordics’ digital infrastructure You’ll join a Nordic group of experienced network engineers working with Internet, IP-VPN, L2 and DDoS mitigation services. Knowledge sharing is a natural part of the job, and you’ll have plenty of opportunities to exchange ideas with colleagues in engineering, product and operations. Why GlobalConnect? Our fiber and network infrastructure forms part of the digital foundation of Scandinavia, carrying connections used by organizations ranging from smaller businesses to hospitals, enterprises and public services. That scale creates interesting engineering problems — and room to explore new technologies, improve how services are built and automated, and broaden your knowledge across the Nordics. To Thrive Here, We Think You Need 5+ years of experience in carrier or large-enterprise networking, including practical underlay work supporting telecom services. Deep technical knowledge of technologies such as BGP, MPLS L3VPN/L2VPN, EVPN, Segment Routing and OSPF/IS-IS, plus experience with multi-tenant services, wholesale interconnects or peering. Practical experience connecting networks with OSS/BSS, orchestration platforms or service controllers using technologies such as REST APIs and YANG/NETCONF. Experience with vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Nokia or Arista is relevant. Fluent in English, fluency in a Scandinavian language is a plus. Based in either Copenhagen, Stockholm, Uppsala, or Oslo, where we have our offices. Ready to help shape what runs underneath the connected Nordics? If you’re motivated by solving substantial technical problems, sharing knowledge and seeing your engineering become reliable services used across society, this could be your next step. At GlobalConnect, you’ll have room to deepen your technical skills while contributing to network infrastructure that matters every day. Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile. We don’t need a personal letter unless there’s something that requires a special explanation and isn’t covered in your CV or LinkedIn profile. We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis. We look forward to hearing from you. About Us GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences. We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well-being, flexibility, and trust. Equality, diversity, and inclusion We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels they can contribute. Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long-term illness or injury. Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing. As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues in various ways including annual bonus schemes. Employee Ownership Our employee ownership model means no external investors, just us, creating a culture of shared success. As your career grows, so does your stake, recognising your long-term impact and contribution. Your voice matters, with the opportunity to connect directly with senior leadership through formal channels to help shape our future. For our senior roles you will have a direct pathway towards ownership from day one. Health and wellbeing Private medical insurance for all UK colleagues. Health cash plan to support you with every day health costs and treatments. Access to Peppy, providing free support from menopause experts for all UK colleagues. Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too. Lifestyle A minimum of 33-35 days holiday each year, inclusive of public holidays and dependent on level, with the ability to buy or sell leave through our flexible benefits programme. Holiday entitlement increased to a minimum of 35 days after 5 years’ service. Variety of employee saving schemes and discounts from high-street retailers. Up to five additional days leave are provided for those with significant caring responsibilities, two of which are paid. Learning and development Primary annual professional institution subscription. A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self-development options. Set and defend priorities, make trade-offs visible to leadership, and document why requests do or do not earn a place on the roadmap. Maintain a coherent product narrative and shared conventions so users experience InAlpha as one platform across the investment lifecycle. Define, instrument, and report product measures for each module across adoption, workflow completion, and output quality, and use the evidence in prioritization. Translate investment workflows and client evidence into actionable requirements with clear acceptance criteria, edge cases, and non-functional expectations. Own the backlog and delivery cadence with engineering leads, establishing predictable releases and a materially improved match between committed and delivered scope by month six. Collaborate closely with design on workflows that reflect how investment professionals review, annotate, and defend an artefact, not simply read it. Own release readiness across configuration, migration of existing client data, documentation, and internal enablement for client-facing teams. Make informed product decisions within the platform architecture and engage directly in technical trade-off discussions with engineering and AI teams. Define expected behavior for AI-driven features, including grounding, citation, uncertainty, incomplete source material, and failure handling. Work with the AI team to define evaluation criteria and assess output quality before release rather than relying on subjective review after launch. Protect enterprise requirements that institutional buyers test directly, including access control, auditability, data residency, and performance at real document volumes. Bring commercial reasoning into prioritization by weighing pipeline impact, renewal risk, delivery cost, and user benefit. Maintain an evidence-based view of competing platforms and adjacent tools, using it to sharpen differentiation without chasing features. Support pricing, packaging, and positioning decisions with usage evidence and a clear view of the value each module creates for clients. Align engineering, AI, design, domain, growth, delivery, and client stakeholders around one current plan; run direct discovery with clients and design partners and convert the evidence into prioritized requirements. Improve requirements quality measurably by reducing rework and clarification cycles between product and engineering. Ship at least one significant cross-module capability into active client use within the first year, with clear adoption evidence attached. Qualifications: What We’re Looking For 8+ years in product management, including several years owning a B2B or enterprise SaaS product end to end rather than executing a roadmap set elsewhere. Product experience in financial services, investment technology, or a data or research platform serving professional investors. Demonstrated ownership of a roadmap across multiple modules, teams, or product areas, with evidence of prioritizing under genuine constraint. Experience working directly with engineering on a modern web and API stack, with the technical fluency to hold credible architecture and delivery trade-off discussions. A track record of shipping products into regulated or otherwise demanding enterprise environments where security, audit, and access control are procurement conditions. Strong requirements craft and written communication, with product documents that clarify decisions, edge cases, and failure behavior without unnecessary follow-up. In einer Bahnwelt, in der Konnektivität zum entscheidenden Differenzierungsmerkmal wird und Technologien wie Starlink neu definieren, was möglich ist, prägst du unmittelbar, wie FlixTrain vorne bleibt und weiterhin hochwertige, unvergessliche Reisen bietet. Als Teil des Product-Development-Teams im Bereich Rolling-Stock & Maintenance sorgst du dafür, dass unsere On-Board-Hardware ein herausragendes Reiseerlebnis für unsere Fahrgäste, einen reibungslosen Betrieb und eine gute Arbeitsumgebung für unser Zugpersonal ermöglicht. Deine Arbeit beeinflusst direkt, wie FlixTrain im Wettbewerb um Konnektivität an Bord die Nase vorn behält und verlässliche, hochwertige Reiseerlebnisse liefert. Über die Rolle Du verantwortest das gesamte On-Board-Technologie-Ökosystem von FlixTrain - WLAN, Netzwerke, On-Board-Units und mobile Endgeräte - und gibst dich nie mit dem Status quo zufrieden Als zentrale technische Ansprechperson für alle On-Board-Systeme bewertest du Spezifikationen, wägst Trade-offs ab und triffst fundierte, gut begründete Entscheidungen Kontinuierlich überwachst du die Performance unserer On-Board-Technologie, erkennst Probleme frühzeitig und treibst Verbesserungen voran, die jede Reise reibungsloser machen Cross-funktionale Projekte rund um Konnektivität, Netzwerk-Performance und die Integration mobiler Endgeräte in die Fahrzeugflotte leitest du eigenverantwortlich und mit klarem Fokus auf Wirkung Technische Spezifikationen und Netzwerkarchitekturen definierst du so, dass sie ambitioniert und zugleich umsetzbar sind und nahtlose Schnittstellen zu unserer Fahrzeugflotte gewährleisten Testszenarien und funktionale Validierungen entwickelst du - besonders an der kritischen Schnittstelle zu Kund*innen und Zertifizierungsstellen – und stellst so sicher, dass unsere Lösungen im echten Betrieb funktionieren Neue Technologien wie 5G, IoT und Starlink behältst du im Blick und übersetzt deine Erkenntnisse in konkrete Empfehlungen für die Technologie-Roadmap von FlixTrain Über Dich Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Telekommunikation, Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich Mit mehr als zwei Jahren praktischer Erfahrung in Netzwerkarchitektur, WLAN-Systemen oder Mobile Device Management überzeugst du -
